name: vitana-pipeline
description: Vitana pipeline (VTID-05275): owner task -> plan( PR -> CI PLAN-SPAR -> CI VTIDs -> up to 6 parallel lanes (code / vitana-lane-reviewer on claude-sonnet-5.5 / land with merge lock) -> staging -> STAGING-VERIFY -> Gate 2. Runbooks: .kiro/pipeline/*.md. Kiro Web: .kiro/pipeline/driver.md.

steps.prompt:
<vitana-platform> = the workspace folder (or its clone) whose `git remote get-url origin` is exafyltd/vitana-platform; <vitana-v1> likewise for exafyltd/vitana-v1. RUN = <vitana-platform>/.agents/tasks/pipeline-<this workflow's id>/ (the wf_... id your step instructions give you). Binding rules: <vitana-platform>/.kiro/pipeline/common-rules.md (read it first). Never ask the owner anything and never send_message severity 'warning' or 'error' for a normal outcome; the only owner stop of the whole pipeline is the Gate 2 step. When this step's work is done, always call send_message with severity 'success'. Owner task (verbatim):
<owner_task>
{{task}}
</owner_task>

Run section 1 (Setup) of <vitana-platform>/.kiro/pipeline/planning.md: create RUN with lanes/, reviews/, timings/, investigate/; write the owner task verbatim to RUN/task.md; session ids into RUN/run.json; fetch both repos; save the queue to RUN/queue.txt; resume an existing open plan for the same task if one exists (record its slug and which steps are already done in RUN/run.json); record CLAUDE_AVAILABLE and the 4 h rule result; pick the slug. Commit nothing. Final message: RUN path, slug, resumed or new, mode.
